description: On the tabletop there are three satin ribbons laid out: a wide light-pink ribbon, a red ribbon, and a thinner pale-pink strip. The right hand reaches in from the right to pinch and pull the red ribbon across and over the wide pink ribbon, then both hands alternate—left hand holding the wide pink ribbon steady while the right hand weaves the red ribbon and the narrow pink strip over and under—tightening and aligning the strands into a loose braid near the top.
